reviews.text:
I met the vet nine years ago, and since then, I've been taking my dog ​​in for grooming and dental care.
Each time, the haircut is adorable, and the tartar removal is done without anesthesia. It's thorough and speedy, and doesn't seem to stress my dog, who only weighs 1-2 kg, at all. When I pick her up, she's always energetic and happy.
There were times when I couldn't get an appointment at the vet and had to go to other salons, but my tiny dog ​​would always come out exhausted and with a decreased appetite.

She'll be 10 soon, and while most tiny dogs seem to have dental problems, thanks to the vet, her teeth are still in great condition.
I'm so grateful to the vet.

The staff were very kind and attentive, and my dog ​​was relaxed. My dog ​​doesn't like having his teeth brushed, but they gave me home care advice, and I think this care will help resolve that issue. The shop has a bright atmosphere, and it's a private salon where you can feel at ease leaving your dog in their care.

WAN&ONE's hotel was even better than I expected!
At night, the owner slept in the same room as us, and we were snuggled up under a down comforter.
It was so comfortable that I thought, "Maybe it's even more comfortable than my own home..." (lol)
I could tell from the relaxed expression on his face when I picked him up that he was truly relaxed.

I regularly use their services for grooming, oral care, and even at daycare,
and it's a place that both my child and I love and feel safe in.
This is a salon I'd like to continue using in the future ♡

I recently attended a dog grooming class. My Chihuahua-Poodle mix hates shampooing, especially since she has a small face and a flat nose, making it difficult to wash her properly. So, I decided to participate to learn the correct shampooing technique from Yu-san, a groomer I trust.

In the class, I learned about nail trimming, filing, and brushing techniques, and then practiced tips for making shampooing less unpleasant.

I learned so many new tips!

When I tried it, she resisted at first, but she became calmer than before. It's not perfect yet, but she seems to be getting used to it little by little!

Yu-san was very kind and answered all my questions thoroughly, which I really appreciated. Because I wasn't feeling well and had to take breaks (thank you for letting me do it without overexerting myself!), we didn't get to the cutting stage, so next time I'd like to focus on learning cutting techniques. I highly recommend this class to anyone who wants to groom their dog at home.

I requested a teeth brushing lesson. I learned invaluable information that I would never get taught at a dental clinic or elsewhere, and it was extremely helpful. I'm frustrated that information in the world, even from animal hospitals, is completely unreliable, but the groomer at this salon is a valuable resource who provides reliable information derived from many years of experience and information that is tailored to the needs of dogs. I sincerely hope that there will be more people like this who are filled with true love for dogs, so that as many dogs as possible can live happy lives.

I have my teeth brushed once a month, and after about two visits, the water bowls I use for drinking water stopped getting slimy altogether. I only do simple cleaning on a daily basis, but I'm able to maintain cleanliness.

I learned about the importance of dogs' teeth from Yuu's (the owner's) YouTube channel.

Although we live far away, we regularly visit for dental maintenance.

Just like humans, if a dog's teeth get bad, they may not be able to eat, and it can lead to various diseases that erode their health. We do everything we can as a family to ensure our beloved dog stays healthy for as long as possible.

Yuu knows a lot about teeth, and we can entrust our dog to her with complete confidence (you can tell just by looking at our dog), so I highly recommend her. She's also excellent at grooming.

We're so grateful for her kind and attentive advice every time!

Yuu's calm demeanor is very soothing for both me and my dog.

We look forward to continuing our relationship! (^^)

I found this salon when I was looking for a grooming salon after bringing home my two-month-old puppy. Many large salons won't groom puppies until their vaccinations are complete, but this private salon was flexible and I was very grateful. The groomer is a veteran, and the grooming is incredibly fast yet the results are beautiful! I've been going there for four years now, and I have two dogs, and they're both taken care of there. My dogs are very attached to Yuu-san ✨ Thank you always ☺️

I used their services for teeth cleaning. My 16-year-old dog had quite a lot of tartar buildup, and I had almost given up hope, but after several visits, his teeth became incredibly clean. I really appreciate how quickly they perform the treatments. Surprisingly, after the tartar started to come off to some extent, my 16-year-old dog's health improved, and his eyes became brighter. I've come to realize the importance of oral health all over again. I want to maintain this condition, so I plan to bring him in regularly.
